usage: music-tagger diff [-h] --evidence EVIDENCE --release RELEASE [-o OUT]

Compute tag diff between local evidence and a MusicBrainz release.

options:
  -h, --help           show this help message and exit
  --evidence EVIDENCE  Evidence JSON from `read`.
  --release RELEASE    Release JSON from `mb release`.
  -o, --out OUT        Output JSON file (prints digest to stdout).
